hero.title: Computer Engineering (PG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A Master’s in Computer Engineering is a postgraduate programme for students interested in computer hardware, embedded systems, computer architecture, digital electronics, networking and the integration of hardware with software. It can help graduates develop advanced technical knowledge for careers in computing, telecommunications, automation and technology research. For Indian applicants exploring a **Master’s in Computer Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students**, it is important to compare available programmes and their specialisations carefully.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for the 2026–2027 academic year does not currently list a dedicated Master’s in Computer Engineering. It lists related options such as an MSc in Artificial Intelligence and an MSc in Software Project Management, while its engineering faculty lists other specialist engineering master’s programmes. These courses are related alternatives, not equivalent qualifications in Computer Engineering. Students planning to **Study Computer Engineering in Mauritius** should verify the course title and curriculum before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Computer Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Computer Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Computer Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
